name: Sweetclaude
description: A full lifecycle software development partner for Claude Code - from concept to completion.
longDescription:
Ships **122 skills**, **11 agents** and **5 hooks**.

- **Skills** (122): `_features` (Feature configuration — shows all optional SweetClaude features with descriptions and current status, lets the user enable or…), `_health` (Consistency scan and version check), `_migrate` (Migration orchestrator), `_route` (Natural language classifier — maps user text to the right internal skill), `behavioral-regression` (Run SweetClaude's behavioral regression test suite), `big-picture` (Show the full project at a glance — roadmap pipeline with milestones, epics, and issues), `bootstrap` (Session startup skill — pre-flight checks, drift/update offers, and initial routing), `claude-config-audit` (Redirects to sweetclaude:doctor), and 114 more
- **Agents** (11): `architecture-reviewer` (Architecture review subagent), `code-reviewer` (Adversarial code review), `implementer` (Isolated implementer for SweetClaude TDD Level 2-3), `performance-reviewer` (Performance review subagent), `qa-caucus-component` (QA Caucus — Component expert), `qa-caucus-integration` (QA Caucus — Integration & cross-cutting expert), `qa-caucus-service` (QA Caucus — Service & API expert), `security-reviewer` (Security review subagent), and 3 more
- **Hooks** (5): `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `Stop`

Installs with `claude plugin install sweetclaude@claude-community` from `carson-sweet/sweetclaude`.
